LanguageData.Psyche_Setting_AttemptWithoutBestMedicin: Attempt therapy without best allowed medicine

When on, counselors hold psyche therapy sessions even when the best medicine allowed for the patient is not in stock, using lesser medicine or none. That lowers quality and can risk a botched, scar-worsening session. When off, a session waits until the best allowed medicine is on hand.
LanguageData.Psyche_SeekClarity_Desc: Send this colonist to contemplate a fully-healed deep psyche scar and try to turn it into a lasting clarity. Consumes {0} glitterworld medicine only if it succeeds. One attempt only. The window closes afterward.
LanguageData.Psyche_SeekClarity_NoGlitter: Requires {0} glitterworld medicine available and unforbidden.
LanguageData.Psyche_Alert_SeekClarity_Desc: These colonists have fully healed a deep psyche scar and can turn it into a lasting clarity through contemplation. It costs {0} glitterworld medicine, and the chance passes after a while.\n\nUse the "Seek clarity" command on the colonist.
LanguageData.Psyche_Reflecting_Desc: This scar has been fully mended. For a short while it can be turned into a lasting clarity through a guided contemplation, costing {0} glitterworld medicine. Use the "Seek clarity" command.
LanguageData.Psyche_ClarityFormed: {0} worked through a healed scar and found a lasting clarity.
LanguageData.Psyche_ClarityFailed: {0} contemplated a healed scar, but no lasting clarity took hold.
LanguageData.Psyche_ScarTradedForAddiction: {0} buried a wound in the habit. Their {1} faded, but a dependency took its place.
LanguageData.Psyche_RevengeClosure: {0} found a measure of peace at the death of {1}, who had taken someone they loved.

LanguageData.Psyche_Tune_WoundScale_Tip: Global multiplier on the size of every psyche injury and boon. Higher means events hit harder.
LanguageData.Psyche_Tune_QualifyingMoodThreshold_Tip: A mood memory qualifies to become a psychlet if its mood effect is at least this large.
LanguageData.Psyche_Tune_QualifyingDurationDays_Tip: A mood memory also qualifies if it lasts at least this many days, regardless of its size.
LanguageData.Psyche_Tune_ConvertedStackLimit_Tip: Most copies of one converted memory that can stack into a single psychlet.

LanguageData.Psyche_Tune_UpkeepChanceReduction_Tip: How much keeping up therapy on an open injury lowers the chance it scars.
LanguageData.Psyche_Tune_TreatmentChanceReduction_Tip: How much a completed treatment lowers the chance an injury scars.
LanguageData.Psyche_Tune_ScarScale_Tip: Multiplier converting an injury's magnitude into the size of the scar it leaves.

LanguageData.Psyche_Tune_MaxHealthFloorFrac_Tip: Scars can never pull a pawn's maximum psyche health below this fraction of baseline.
